notes: Three separate groups is correct for this booklet and I kept it. Page 1 builds the policeman minifigure, the radio stand (steps 1-3) and the car as three independent models. The final picture on page 2 shows the stand and the minifigure standing next to the car, not attached to it.
Group 1 is the police car, b1-b48 plus the sticker sheet b56. Group 2 is the radio stand with antenna and loudhailer, b49-b54. Group 3 is the 3962b radio, b55, which the minifigure holds.
The minifigure's hat, torso and legs aren't in the official parts list, so they are not recorded. That leaves the radio with nothing to attach to, and I did not invent a connection for it.
Parts list totals 56 and the model has 56 pieces (b1-b56).

The booklet pictures are small, so the exact stud placement of several pieces is my best guess: the 3020 plates, 51739 wedge, 43337 panels, 52501 sills, the 3004 bricks and the 3069b tile. Counts and colours match the parts list.

The two 54200 Trans-Red slopes are on the rear bumper, the Trans-Yellow ones are the headlights, and the Trans-Dark Blue ones are the light bar. The light bar is a 3710 with a 3023 on top and a 2412b grille on the 3023.
The 2431 tiles are attached to the underside of the bumper bricks, so they rest on nothing and are joined through other_joins.
The two white 298c02 levers are the roof antennas on the rear 3710. The 3957a is the pole of the radio stand and sits in the 4032a round plate.
The 52814 sticker sheet is joined to b23 only as a stand-in for the sticker positions.
The wheels pivot on the four wheel-holder pins of the two black 6157 plates, which are on the base's end studs.
